shortDescription: Set  Cellular runtime information and Parameters of the WTI device.

options.name: apn
options.description: APN for the cellular modem in the WTI device.

options.name: cellenable
options.description: If the cellular modem is enabled in the WTI device.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: ipthru_enabled
options.description: Enables/disables the IP Passthrough feature.

options.name: ipthru_httpsterm
options.description: When IP Passthrough is enabled, the Cellular HTTPS Port will be incremented by 5000.

options.name: ipthru_httpstermenable
options.description: Enables/disables HTTPS.

options.name: ipthru_httpterm
options.description: When IP Passthrough is enabled, the Cellular HTTP Port will be incremented by 5000.

options.name: ipthru_httptermenable
options.description: Enables/disables HTTP.

options.name: ipthru_interfacemon
options.description: Selects the interface that your downstream device/router will be connected to.

options.name: ipthru_mac
options.description: The MAC address of your downstream device/router.

options.name: ipthru_sshterm
options.description: When IP Passthrough is enabled, the Cellular SSH Port will be incremented by 5000.

options.name: ipthru_sshtermenable
options.description: Enables/disables SSH.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wof_afppinginter1
options.description: Determines how often the Ping command will be sent after a previous Ping command receives no response.

options.name: wof_autorecov
options.description: When enabled, the cellular modem will automatically be put back into sleep state when failure is resolved.

options.name: wof_conscfail1
options.description: Determines how many consecutive failures pings must be detected in order to initiate a Wakeup on Failure..

options.name: wof_enabled
options.description: Enables/disables the Wakeup on Failure feature.

options.name: wof_gatewayaddr
options.description: When the cellular modem is defined as the default gateway, this determines which interface will be the default gateway.

options.name: wof_gatewayport
options.description: The Ethernet port that will be used as the default gateway when the cellular modem is in the sleep state.

options.name: wof_host1
options.description: Selects the primary host that will be pinged in order to test for failures.

options.name: wof_host2
options.description: Selects the secondary host that will be pinged in order to test for failures.

options.name: wof_interfacemon
options.description: Selects the Ethernet interface(s) that will be monitored for failed ping responses.

options.name: wof_pinginter1
options.description: Determines how often the selected IP Address will be pinged.

options.name: wof_singlepingaddfail
options.description: After an Ethernet failure has triggered a Wakeup, this feature is used to manually re-enable Wakeup On Failure.

options.name: wof_sleepmode
options.description: Determines whether the cell modem will be attached or detached from the cell tower when sleep mode is active.
